verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at docs.lithic.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, structured as a Lithic developer docs index). The docs are also served as .md pages, and the official MCP server lets AI assistants search Lithic documentation and inspect endpoint schemas from inside Cursor, Claude Code, and Copilot. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt content depth or coverage beyond the truncated header, and independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs successfully.
